symptom: dnf / RunPatchBaseline fails writing packages or SSM payload, or the orchestrator precheck stops the patch because root free space is below threshold; / or /var near 100%
root_cause: root volume full (large files in /var/tmp or /tmp, dnf cache, journal)
fix: PatchRemediate-FreeDisk, then rerun patch. If still >90% full escalate for EBS resize.

symptom: dnf cannot load metadata for one repo, whole transaction aborts
root_cause: a third-party / internal mirror repo is unreachable or misconfigured (skip_if_unavailable=False)
fix: identify the non-Amazon repo id with run_diagnostic(repos); PatchRemediate-DisableRepo RepoId=<id>; rerun; notify repo owner

root_cause: SSM agent stopped or instance hung; nothing can be fixed through SSM
fix: no SSM remediation possible. request_human_action restart_ssm_agent (EC2 serial console / reboot after approval)
